messages:
Mira (PM): Heads-up — TideBank is seeing intermittent 500ms+ tail latencies on embedding calls since last deploy. CS opened P1 ticket. @Jordan (Eng Lead) @Priya (SRE) can you take a look?
Jordan (Eng Lead): on it. can you drop the ticket link and a short repro? also, which deployment rolled yesterday?
Casey (Support): ticket #TB-4721: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TB-4721 — they repro with batch embedding endpoint /v1/embeddings, payload size ~120 vectors. Spike started ~09:12 UTC after deploy-2026-03-17-emb-v2.
Priya (SRE): thanks. initial metric check: dedicated-pool-7 GPU utilization jumped to 93% and queue depth spiked. autoscale didn't kick fast enough due to minPool=2 config.
deploy-bot: deploy event: deploy-2026-03-17-emb-v2 by jordan at 1864123200 — image: emb-service:v2.3.4
Jordan (Eng Lead): ok. two immediate options: 1) scale pool now (fast) 2) rollback to emb-v1 (risk config drift). Priya, can you scale?
Priya (SRE): scaling now -> increasing dedicated-pool-7 from 2 -> 4 instances, target 10m. I'll also temporarily raise concurrent request limit for embeddings to avoid queue pressure.
Mira (PM): I'll tell TideBank we're investigating, ETA 2h for mitigation. CS told them we'll update in 30m.
Jordan (Eng Lead): quick ask — any chance this is a model-change perf regression? did v2 change chunking? @Priya any logs showing slower per-token time?
Priya (SRE): perf sample:
```
2026-03-17T09:15:32Z emb-service: request_id=xxxyyy latency=512ms model=emb-large-v2 seq_len=1024
2026-03-17T09:15:34Z emb-service: request_id=aaabbb latency=498ms model=emb-large-v2 seq_len=512
```
No clear token-slowdown vs v1 in CPU-bound metrics; looks like queueing + larger batch sizes from client.
Casey (Support): customer says they switched to batch of 120 vectors after a retry change on their side. we suggested batch_size 32 as interim.
Jordan (Eng Lead): OK. I'll open an infra PR to add a rate-based throttling fallback for oversized batches and a quick canary rollback PR in case scaling doesn't stabilize. PRs: #4021 (throttle), #4022 (rollback). Need 1 reviewer from eng-runtime.
Priya (SRE): pool scaled. queue depth dropping from 87 -> 12 in last 6m. preemptively set autoscale cooldown to 30s.
Mira (PM): nice. Can we commit owner/time for next actions? Jordan: investigate root cause & merge throttling PR within 4h. Priya: observe for 2h and revert cooldown to default after stability. Casey: notify customer in 30m with interim guidance (batch 32) and ETA.
Jordan (Eng Lead): commit: 4h for PR + deploy canary, will ping @eng-runtime for review. If instability persists after 30m, rollback to emb-v1 within 2h.
Priya (SRE): commit: monitoring window 2h, will escalate to oncall if queue > 50 again.
Casey (Support): committing to customer update in 25m.
ops-bot: alert muted for TB-4721 for 60m (mute_by=Mira)
Mira (PM): thanks everyone. I'll follow up in 30m with update. :thumbsup:
